Across 12 families x 6 comparators (72 tests), plain Firefly has 5 WIN, 24 LOSS and 43 TIE (Holm within family, alpha 0.05); per comparator: anova 1W/3L/8T, mi 2W/2L/8T, l1 1W/3L/8T, rf 0W/8L/4T, pca 0W/8L/4T, pso 1W/0L/11T. (paired Wilcoxon, Holm within family, n=10; n = 10 seeds limits power: the smallest two-sided Wilcoxon p is about 0.002, so a Holm-adjusted WIN or LOSS needs nearly all seeds to agree.)
